description: Metro Manila movie showtimes as a CLI — every tracked cinema in one now-playing board, cross-checked across two sources.

novel_features.name: Now-playing board
novel_features.description: Every movie showing today across all tracked Metro Manila and Iloilo cinemas, in one call.

novel_features.name: Movie showtime finder
novel_features.description: Find which tracked theaters are playing a given movie today, and at what times.

novel_features.name: Two-source showtime cross-check
novel_features.description: Flags each showtime as verified (two sources agree), partial, mismatched, or ClickTheCity-only by cross-checking popcorn.app.

novel_features.name: IMDb resolver
novel_features.description: Resolves a movie title to its IMDb page, flagging remake/re-release title collisions by recent year.

novel_features.name: Tracked theater registry
novel_features.description: Lists every tracked cinema with its ClickTheCity slug, display name, and city.
